name: 06_diff_positive_resets
description: [H2] System-A gate fails (weighted_vwap_diff slightly positive) so System A resets; System B is DECOUPLED and arms on its own condition (current_return -3.0 <= bleed_arm -1.0).
derivation: Outer guard passes (is_triggered=False). Weight 0.7 > 0.5 passes the weight clause, but diff 0.25 < 0 is FALSE -> System-A gate fails. System A resets vwap_ticks to 0 (confirms the AND-gate: either clause failing trips the System-A reset). [H2 DECOUPLING] System B independent: arm -3.0 <= -1.0 TRUE -> new_vwap_bleed_ticks = 5+1 = 6; is_vwap_bleed_broken = (6 >= 3) TRUE. Returns (0, 6, False, True). Pre-H2 wrongly expected (0,0,False,False).
